title: Preserve workspace root when parsing direct read commands
goal: Make supported direct Vietnamese and English workspace-read phrases execute against the intended workspace-relative path rather than stripping the required workspace root and failing as malformed input.
context: SkillRuntime.parseWorkspaceReadPath advertises prefixes such as “đọc workspace/” and “read workspace/”, but strips the entire prefix including “workspace/”. The resulting relative path no longer passes isWorkspaceReadPath, which requires the workspace/ root. Existing integration tests cover “đọc file workspace/...” but not the direct forms.
forbidden_changes: Do not weaken path validation, traversal checks, or workspace capability gating.
Do not change executor identity binding, policy behavior, or output verification.
Do not modify UI, provider, storage, terminal, or unrelated composition code.
acceptance_criteria: Direct Vietnamese and English workspace-read prefixes preserve the workspace/ root.
Existing file-read phrasing and security checks continue to pass.
Regression tests prove the direct command reads the real file and returns verified output.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: Revert the single squashed task commit if direct workspace-read commands regress; retain existing path-root and traversal validation.
